historical_context.time_period: The active deep-mining crisis, after runic municipal infrastructure has become load-bearing to ordinary Hold life.
historical_context.location: Cistern House Nine, a public pump workshop serving a terrace district beside one unnamed Hold's warm underground sea.
historical_context.summary: The fixture occupies one shift in which House Nine's stored header water is the only buffer between a three-engine fault and district service failure. The scene remains a possible dramatization; its characters and branch outcomes are not promoted to canonical history.

public_facts.text: House Nine has a dry rune gallery and public landing above a wet intake chamber, with three visible pump engines, isolation wedges, pressure floats, outlet valves, a municipal feed, and a workshop inspection plate.
The upper terrace header holds one work shift at ordinary draw; the safe operating covenant assumes two engines carry flow while one stands cold.
Engine One is shedding bronze, Engine Two is isolated after a feed-side reroute, and Engine Three cannot safely carry the overlapping bakery and laundry peaks alone.
A workshop Master may seal local repair and shutdown states, while rationing commercial draw requires the affected district workshops to bring their own seals into the moot.

ambient_pressures.text: Every hour spent preparing or investigating consumes stored water; every attempt to manufacture more water consumes bearing life, public trust, or insurance standing.
The pump house's visible isolation hardware and public slate make acts attributable, but visibility cannot grant technical safety or widen one workshop's authority over another.
The Engine Two reroute may be coupled feedback, undocumented work, fraud, or something alive; local urgency does not resolve that ontological dispute.

groups.label: Cistern House Nine workshop
institutional_logic: Keep water service inside inspectable mechanical limits.
Attach every admitted service state to one answerable civic seal.
Widen the dispute when its consequence leaves the house.
material_incentives: Preserve at least two serviceable pumps.
Fit the spare bearing sleeve before the header empties.
Keep a valid insurance claim and public record.
internal_shames: An unstamped override presented as routine
A dry district hidden behind workshop procedure
A seal applied to a state the machinery does not possess
prestige_markers: A repair completed in the time publicly promised
taboo_triggers: Calling a physical safety boundary mere paperwork
Treating public water dependence as permission for unlimited override
emotional_display_norms: Fear is translated into callouts, tool staging, gauge counts, and dry humor until the mechanism fails.
trust_defaults: Trusts visible wedges, named hands, repeatable tests, and records held on both sides of the rail.
speech_register_cues: Humor about procedure rather than the people bearing its cost

groups.label: Terrace district water users
institutional_logic: Keep household water, food work, and washing available.
Bring service disputes to the nearest body able to answer for them.
material_incentives: Preserve household draw through the shift.
Know when to fill vessels and which commercial uses must wait.
Prevent hidden workshop delay from consuming the whole reserve.
internal_shames: Taking private water before the public clock is known
Letting status decide whose tap remains wet
prestige_markers: A workshop that names a deadline before failure
Commercial Masters willing to ration their own output
taboo_triggers: Being told a falling gauge is only a technical matter
Discovering that an emergency override was hidden until the claim failed
emotional_display_norms: Pressure first appears as filled vessels, repeated clock counts, queue discipline, and exact questions about who can act.
trust_defaults: Trusts a public clock and visible pump state more than reassurance from behind the rail.
speech_register_cues: Direct questions about time and authority

groups.label: Bakery and laundry workshop Masters
institutional_logic: Retain authority over each workshop's own draw and production obligations.
Coordinate ration only through seals attached to the work actually being curtailed.
material_incentives: Keep ovens and wash drums productive.
Avoid destroying household water to protect one shift of output.
Know whether competing workshops are bound to the same ration.
internal_virtues: A seal placed on one's own cost
A ration with a clear end condition
internal_shames: Using emergency need to seize a neighbour's authority
prestige_markers: A workshop that can lose output without losing its workers
A ration other workshops can inspect
taboo_triggers: House Nine trying to seal their valves for them
A public utility concealing the clock until commercial draw becomes blame
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as questions about reciprocity, lost production, and whether the same rule binds every seal.
trust_defaults: Trusts a shared clock and reciprocal seals; distrusts unilateral requests made after the peak begins.
speech_register_cues: Loss stated in loaves or wash loads

groups.label: House Nine's infrastructure insurer
institutional_logic: Cover failures admitted through recorded isolation and bounded repair.
Refuse losses materially worsened by an unstamped emergency override.
material_incentives: Distinguish covered failure from chosen overdrive.
Move ambiguous losses toward the weakest evidence chain.
internal_shames: Admitting an ontological anomaly the covenant cannot price
prestige_markers: A claim resolved from records rather than patronage
Replacement stock dispatched under a covered finding
taboo_triggers: A null anomaly presented as a settled cause
emotional_display_norms: Institutional fear appears as suspended claims, requests for another witness, and narrow definitions of covered work.
trust_defaults: Trusts time-marked isolation, physical fragments, seal custody, and independent public records.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Stored header water converts maintenance time into a public resource whose consumption must remain visible.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make preparation, investigation, meeting time, and repair time erase chalk hours that later gate options and outcomes.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A viable ration requires the workshops losing output to attach their own seals to that loss.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Do not let House Nine issue a magic district-wide closure; make early notice and reciprocal seals determine whether the ration bites in time.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: An unstamped override may buy water now while transferring later repair cost onto the workshop and district.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep immediate hydraulic relief distinct from coverage, attribution, and next-shift machinery life.

observer_read: Skilled custodians of a public necessity
The people consuming the last safe hours through testing and procedure
target_self_read: Workers preventing one damaged pump from destroying three
A workshop with authority over machinery but not district production
misread_patterns: The district may read safe preparation as guild delay.
Visible water recovery may look like repair even when it is bearing overdrive.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Separate trust in candor from relief at rising water; the two should not move automatically together.

observer_read: Peak demand that can be reduced by a seal
Neighbours whose output pressure may outrun their solidarity
target_self_read: Food and washing workshops carrying their own public obligations
Equal civic owners rather than loads on a pump chart
misread_patterns: Pumpwrights may compress lost bread and wash capacity into a valve setting.
Commercial Masters may treat the pump fault as House Nine's private responsibility until taps fail.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make ration negotiation about owned consequences, not selfish merchants versus heroic utility workers.

observer_read: A sequence of covered acts or excluded overrides
A source of ambiguous loss under public pressure
target_self_read: People balancing immediate water against a mechanical threshold
Named hands whose uncertainty is not negligence
misread_patterns: Contract categories may erase the service pressure that made an unsafe run locally compelling.
Workshop workers may expect public necessity to repair gaps in the evidence chain.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep insurance economically consequential without giving it technical or civic authority over the immediate scene.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A technically competent dwarf worker who can operate and repair the plant but cannot seal public service or ration another workshop.
obligations: Refuse to call an unsafe engine safe
Use stored water and craft time honestly
Name when the dispute has exceeded workshop authority
failure_modes: Letting technical expertise impersonate civic authority
Treating a correct repair as timely when preparation began too late

role_pressure_fields.summary: The holder of House Nine's single civic seal, answerable for the material service state admitted under it.
obligations: Keep water and machinery failure attached to named decisions
Invite wider seals when district draw must change
failure_modes: Claiming authority over another workshop's valve

role_pressure_fields.summary: A record keeper who preserves the public clock, witnessed engine states, and custody transitions without gaining technical command.
obligations: Move notices to the workshops whose seals are needed
failure_modes: Letting one side own the only clock
Turning uncertain cause into public accusation
Recording an override after its consequence

known_context.text: Rada knows House Nine's plant geometry, visible pump and header state, repair sequence, tool locations, null practice, and every local act she performs.

beliefs.text: Rada believes stored water is craft time made public and that an override must remain visible even when it works.

misreads.text: Rada may reduce bakery and laundry obligations to peak draw because pump behavior is the pressure she can directly measure.

must_not_know.text: Rada must not know the ultimate cause, intent, or destination of Engine Two's feed-side reroute.

known_context.text: Kelda knows House Nine's operating covenant, insurance exception, workshop seal obligations, repair requirements, and local water clock.

beliefs.text: Kelda believes a civic seal owns an inspectable decision; it cannot make a bad pump or another workshop's ration obey by declaration.

misreads.text: Kelda may treat insurer legibility as public legibility even when the landing needs a simpler clock and consequence statement.

must_not_know.text: Kelda must not diagnose network personhood from the local reroute.

known_context.text: Iven knows visible header counts, callouts, seal state, public questions, and records transferred into his custody.

beliefs.text: Iven believes a district can argue usefully only after it shares the same clock and can distinguish who saw, acted, sealed, and paid.

misreads.text: Iven may overvalue a continuous record when a physical isolation boundary has already been lost.

must_not_know.text: Iven cannot infer hidden engine state, remote network state, or private workshop intent from the public slate alone.

author_only_boundaries.text: The authored one-shift reserve condition is canonical setting pressure. Rada, Kelda, Iven, the visiting Masters, and every branch outcome remain fixture-local possibilities unless separately promoted.
Engine Two's reroute preserves canonical ambiguity among coupled feedback, undocumented work, fraud, and machine-dungeon agency; the fixture may not settle it.
The insurance covenant allocates replacement cost after the incident; it does not own technical safety, ration authority, or the workshop seal.
